question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Insightful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insightful"** means having a deep understanding or the ability to perceive clearly; it refers to someone who is perceptive, intelligent, and discerning. (गहरी समझ या अंतर्दृष्टि वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** Her insightful comments during the meeting helped the team make better decisions.
 
 
 
• **"Unperceptive"** refers to someone who lacks the ability to notice or understand things clearly; it is the opposite of being insightful. (असंवेदनशील या समझ की कमी वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** His unperceptive remarks showed that he hadn't understood the complexity of the issue.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Insightful'** is **'Unperceptive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Jagged** (खुरदरा): Having a rough or uneven surface or outline.

 
 
• **Example:** The jagged edges of the broken glass made it dangerous to handle.
 
 
 
• **Terminal** (अंतिम): Referring to the end of something, often used in the context of transportation hubs or illnesses.
 
 
• **Example:** She boarded the flight from the international terminal.
 
 
 
• **Elite** (श्रेष्ठ): Referring to a select group that is superior in terms of ability or qualities.
 
 
• **Example:** The elite athletes competed for the championship title.
